text: I think you'll really enjoy this Mexican Chorizo recipe. It features dried oregano, an ingredient you've shown a clear preference for in your past reviews. The recipe itself is quick and easy to make, ready in just 15 minutes, which is a great bonus. The nutritional information is also relatively balanced, with a good mix of protein, fat, and complex carbohydrates. Overall, this recipe seems like a great fit for your tastes and cooking style. Give it a try and see what you think!
